name: Mitaka Jin
source: Jin is the former resident of room 103, and a third-year student of Suiko. He is Misaki Kamiigusa's childhood friend and a giant playboy. He has dated several girls, including Fuuka Kamiigusa, but in the end he breaks up with all of them.
